title: Microsoft hits 10 quarters of record-breaking revenue in a row | TechCrunch
summary: The record-breaking income was largely driven on the strength of Microsoft Cloud, which reached $63.9 billion in revenue this quarter, an increase of 30% over the year-ago quarter, Microsoft said.
